source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: What To Do With Prayer Beads
source_excerpt:
As you explore the numerous regions of Phantom Blade Zero , you will find key items linked to main story quests , side quests, and NPC interactions. One such item is the Prayer Beads , which you can acquire in Weeping Creek Valley and turn in shortly afterward in the Village of Lu . This guide covers where to find the necessary NPC and how your dialogue choice affects the outcome.
How to Get the Prayer Beads in Phantom Blade Zero
After completing the second region, Crimson Forest, you will make your way to the Village of Lu. If you return to the Outpost Bell in Weeping Creek Valley, you will find that the NPCs have turned into enemies, with some even fighting each other. You will also notice the western side of Outpost is now accessible.
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
Deal with the hostile guards, then check on the NPCs in the area. Afterward, head down the path to find the Monk and the shopkeeper. The Monk has a very sturdy Sha-Chi bar, so you will need to use a heavy two-handed weapon or the Dread Axe Phantom Edge to deal with him. Once you defeat the Monk, he will drop the Prayer Beads.
Where to Use the Prayer Beads in Phantom Blade Zero
With the Prayer Beads in your possession, progress through the Village of Lu and head to the northeastern part of the region, where you can find the Survivors' Courtyard Bell. There are a couple of NPCs here, along with a Monk standing near a tree. Speak to him, and he will ask whether you believe in the Lady of the Veil.
If you tell him that you do believe in her, he will turn to stone, automatically completing the Leave None Alive quest. However, if you choose the other dialogue option and Soul tells him that he does not believe in her, you will be tasked with bringing Huijue's relics to the Stately Monk nearby.
Choose the option to hand over Huijue's relics. He will return the relics, but they will have been transformed into the Agarwood Prayer Beads . This accessory increases Sha-Chi recovery by 15% while Guard-Broken. After giving you the accessory, the Monk will turn to stone, completing the Leave None Alive quest.
